summary.text: Tom Brandt is a member of the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature representing District 32, and was elected in 2018 and re-elected in 2022, according to the Legislature's biography.
The Legislature lists Tom Brandt's occupation as a farmer.

paragraphs.text: Tom Brandt was born on December 1, 1959, in Beatrice.
Tom Brandt graduated from Tri County High School in 1978 and earned a B.S. in agricultural economics and mechanized agriculture from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln in 1982.
Tom Brandt worked as an industrial engineer at Oscar Mayer/Louis Rich and as a project engineer at IBP.
Tom Brandt is president of the Plymouth Improvement Association and congregation president of First Trinity Lutheran Church.
Tom Brandt married Sandra Rodriguez on August 6, 1988, and they have two children.
